text:
Marta Silva: Quick sync 1: customer asks for a quota "burst preview" UI so they can see how many short spikes remain in their free monthly bucket. Wants API + console + webhook when near depletion.
Omar Haddad: We can expose remaining burst tokens and a per-tenant recent-burst history. Webhook makes sense for alerting.
Jon Park: Ops note: exposing detailed burst state risks support load if customers misinterpret. Keep default summary + an advanced view guarded by a permission.
Leah Summers: UX idea: show a 30s/2m/5m equivalent token meter and expected remaining for X QPS spike. Also preview invoiced overage estimate if they exceed.
Marta Silva: Launch criteria: 1) API + console meters live; 2) webhook docs + sample; 3) pilot with 2 customers; 4) no more than 2 support tickets per pilot customer about confusion.
Omar Haddad: Implementation plan: a) aggregator service that computes sliding-window burst consumption b) API endpoints + webhook emitter c) console panel + invoice preview svc. Estimate 4 infra-weeks + 1 console-week.
Jon Park: Autoscale interaction: spike-preview must not be used to trigger autoscale. Add clear note and block in the autoscale estimator.
Leah Summers: Prioritization: P0 for customers with active Dedicated contracts. Scoped MVP: read-only UI + webhook; delay invoice preview to phase 2. That should fit a 4-sprint cadence.
ScaleBot: reminder scheduled: run burst-sim on 1795059000.
Marta Silva: Action items: Omar -> aggregator proto by Wed; Jon -> autoscale block PR by Fri; Leah -> console mockups by Mon; I'll draft pilot outreach. Thanks.
